scores.notes: Peter is the man leaping from the boat (left) and the standing man with the net by the fire (right): both have short curly dark hair greying at the temples, a greying short beard, weathered middle-aged face and stocky build in a brown coat.

Same kind of wooden plank boat with single rope-wrapped mast on a wave-tossed lake ringed by low hills under dark storm cloud; the left shows brightening sky as the calm asked for, the sail is simply out of frame.

Both show a dark storm-clouded teal sea opening onto a wet sandy, rock-strewn seabed; the left is the shore view as the waters begin to divide and the right is the corridor between the risen walls, a compatible later viewpoint.

Both show a sandy wet seabed corridor between towering blue-green water walls under broken cloud, ending at red mesa cliffs on the shore; the scrub on the right-hand ground is a minor difference only.

Daniel (standing by the angel, left; holding the rope, right) is in both an older brown-skinned man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, slim build, in the same blue robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder bag.

Daniel (hauled up on the rope, left; standing in the light shaft, right) is in both a lean older man with short grey hair, trimmed grey beard and tan skin, wearing the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a small bag.

Both show a pale dawn lake ringed by tawny hills with a pebbly shore, a small fire on the beach and a wooden fishing boat just offshore; the palms and houses seen from the water on the right would be out of frame in the left's along-shore view.

Both show a sand corridor through green-teal curling sea walls ending at pale sand dunes on the shore; the left is a higher, drier, stormier-skied view with lower walls and the right adds red cliffs, but land, water and dunes are compatible.

Jesus (crouching at the fire, left; standing in the boat, right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and age, and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.

Both show the same grey-green heaving sea dividing to expose a tan sandy, rock-strewn bed under grey storm cloud; the left is the near-shore view as the path opens and the right looks along the corridor to a dune shore, with no conflicting feature.

Both show a sandy, rock- and weed-littered seabed beside dark blue-green breaking sea on a desert shore; the right (the all-night parting) is much darker-skied with palms on the bank, the left is the opened corridor in grey daylight, and the land and water are compatible.

The den's structure conflicts: left is a roofed, dome-shaped stone chamber narrowing to a small round opening beside a barred window, right is a wide open-topped cylinder of pale blocks with vertical walls, a hinged wooden cover and a straw floor.

Both show the same style of open wooden plank boat with plain upright stem and stern posts and a single rope-stayed mast, on a grey-green choppy lake under storm cloud with green-brown hills and a shoreline village behind; the left only shows the clearing sky asked for.

Both show a dark storm-lit teal sea opened over a wet, rocky, weed-strewn brown seabed under heavy black cloud; the left looks along the corridor between the towering walls and the right from the cliff-backed bank as the path opens, which are compatible.

Both show a dark-timbered open boat with a rope-bound mast, coiled ropes and Jesus on a cushion in the stern, swamped by white-capped blue-black waves under black storm cloud; the left is a closer, darker view with no shore in frame but nothing conflicts.

Both show sunlit dry hill country with terraced slopes, olive trees, cypresses, a pale dirt road and flat-roofed pale stone houses with low stone walls; the left is the road outside the village, the right the yard among those houses.

Both show a deep circular pit lined with large grey ashlar blocks, open to daylight at a rim where the king and guards lean over, with lions on a bare dirt floor; the left is the view from the courtyard above and the right from the floor, with only part of the top arched over.

Peter (the dripping-wet man in the ragged brown coat facing Jesus, left; the man leaping from the boat, right) has in both short curly hair, a grizzled short beard, weathered tanned face and stocky build; his hair reads greyer on the right but the beard, face and age band agree.

Moses (pointing from the bank, left; centre front with staff, right) is in both an elderly man with swept-back white hair and a long full white beard, tanned lined face and same build, in a cream tunic with a dark brown cloak.

Both show dry terraced hill country with olive trees, pale dirt ground, dry-stone walls and flat-roofed pale stone houses; the left is the road with the houses in the distance and the right the yard among them, a compatible closer viewpoint.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, coiled ropes and a stern cushion on a dark sea under storm cloud; the right is a close view in the storm with no shore visible, which the left's distant hills do not contradict.
Peter (wading ashore on the left, leaping from the boat on the right) has the same curly grey-streaked dark hair, short grey beard, weathered middle-aged face and sturdy build in both.

Both show a grey overcast lake with a small fire on a low stony shore and misty hills across the water; left looks at the shore from the boat and right looks out from the pebble beach toward a village point, which is compatible.

Both show a circular pit lined with large grey stone blocks holding lions on a sandy floor, with a stone parapet at the mouth; the left is seen from inside and looks more enclosed above, the right from outside in a sandy palace yard, which a change of viewpoint can cover.

Moses is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, carrying a tall crook-topped staff and wearing a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both; on the right he is seen partly from behind with wind-blown hair, but hair colour, beard and age agree.
The left shows only a rocky palm-lined shore at night with the sea still unparted, so the dry path itself is not there to compare with the right's sandy corridor between water walls and red cliffs.

Both show an open wooden plank boat with a rope-bound mast on a dark blue choppy lake with low green-grey hills under storm cloud; the left's curled sternpost is cropped out of the right's closer deck view, so nothing visible conflicts.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short dark beard, a slim face and a blue cloak over a white tunic in both the boat and the shore scene.

Left shows a courtyard among pale flat-roofed stone houses on a terraced olive hillside; right shows a dirt road through the same kind of olive scrub leading to a pale flat-roofed stone farmstead with walled yards, which fits the same homestead seen from afar.
Both show the same kind of open wooden boat with a single mast, pale patched sail and square rope-bound end posts on a grey-green stormy lake with a low green-brown ridge on the far shore.

Moses is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak over a pale tunic holding a tall staff in both; his hair is wilder in the wind on the left and he is seen in part-profile, but age, hair and beard colour agree.

Both show an open wooden boat with a single rope-bound mast and a tall rope-wrapped sternpost by the sleeper's cushion, in white-capped dark waves with a dark cliffed shore at right; the post ends in a curl on the right and is squared on the left, a small difference.

Both show an open wooden boat with a single mast and plain square rope-bound end posts on a grey-green choppy lake with low green-tan hills on the far shore under storm cloud, clearing on the right as the text asks.
Daniel has the same close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard, brown skin and lean older face in both, with the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic and a small shoulder satchel.
Both show a calm pale-blue lake with a low pebbly sandy shore, a small fire near the waterline, olive trees and cypresses, small stone buildings and soft tan hills across the water in clear daylight.
Both show a wet sandy seabed strewn with rocks, shells and weed between towering teal wave walls under heavy storm cloud with a pale break in the sky at the far end of the corridor.

Both show a sandy path opening between green wave walls in grey daylight under a cloudy sky, starting from a sandy shore backed by red-tan sandstone cliffs; the right is the shore as the path forms and the left is inside the corridor looking back at those cliffs.
Jesus has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, long slim face and build, with a blue-grey cloak over a white tunic, in both the boat and the shore scene.

Both show a dark open wooden boat with a single rope-rigged mast and a stern cushion on a grey-green lake ringed by dark cliffed hills under heavy cloud; the storm on the left gives way to breaking light on the right as the text asks.
